```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", "->", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("([0-9]) ([0-9]{3}\\b)", "\\1~\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9]) ([0-9]{3}\\b)", "\\1~\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", "->", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

render_table_template <- function (arg0_df, arg1_options = NULL) {
  df <- as.data.frame(arg0_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()

  caption_str <- if (!is.null(options$caption)) as.character(options$caption) else ""
  col_names <- if (!is.null(options$col_names)) as.character(options$col_names) else colnames(df)
  euro_decimals <- if (!is.null(options$euro_decimals)) isTRUE(options$euro_decimals) else TRUE
  is_latex <- if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) knitr::is_latex_output() else FALSE
  label_str <- if (!is.null(options$label)) as.character(options$label) else ""

  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  n_rows <- nrow(df)
  if (n_rows == 0 || n_cols == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  if (length(col_names) != n_cols) {
    col_names <- colnames(df)
  }
  col_names <- gsub("`", "", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\n", " ", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("([0-9])\\s+(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", col_names, perl = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\u2013", "-", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  for (c_i in seq_len(n_cols)) {
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("`", "", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\\*\\*", "", as.character(df[[c_i]]))
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\u2013", "-", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("---", " - ", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("--", "-", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("([0-9])\\s+(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", as.character(df[[c_i]]), perl = TRUE)
  }

  if (!is_latex) {
    disp_df <- df
    colnames(disp_df) <- col_names
    for (c_idx in seq_len(n_cols)) {
      disp_df[[c_idx]] <- vapply(
        disp_df[[c_idx]],
        function (v) format_table_cell(v, c_idx, list(bold_first_col = FALSE, euro_decimals = euro_decimals, is_latex = FALSE)),
        character(1)
      )
    }
    kb <- knitr::kable(disp_df, format = "markdown", caption = if (nzchar(caption_str)) caption_str else NULL)
    return(knitr::asis_output(paste(as.character(kb), collapse = "\n")))
  }

  # Calculate safe usable fraction of \textwidth accounting for (n_cols - 1) inter-column gaps
  usable_frac <- max(0.78, 0.962 - 0.0132 * (n_cols - 1L))

  min_frac <- numeric(n_cols)
  col_weights <- numeric(n_cols)
  for (c_idx in seq_len(n_cols)) {
    hdr_str <- col_names[c_idx]
    hdr_words <- unlist(strsplit(hdr_str, "[\\s/\\-]+", perl = TRUE))
    hdr_max_w <- min(11L, max(nchar(hdr_words), 3L))

    cell_vec <- as.character(df[[c_idx]])
    # Treat thousands-separated numbers (1 280,0k) and dates (10000BC) as single unbreakable tokens
    cell_vec_joined <- gsub("([0-9]) ([0-9]{3}\\b)", "\\1_\\2", cell_vec, perl = TRUE)
    cell_vec_joined <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", cell_vec_joined, perl = TRUE)
    cell_words <- unlist(strsplit(paste(cell_vec_joined, collapse = " "), "[\\s/]+", perl = TRUE))
    cell_max_w <- min(11L, max(nchar(cell_words), 3L))

    # Word-fit floor in fraction of 468pt textwidth
    req_pts <- max(hdr_max_w * 5.1 + 4.0, cell_max_w * 4.7 + 4.0, 30.0)
    min_frac[c_idx] <- req_pts / 468.0

    cell_lens <- nchar(cell_vec)
    cell_q85 <- as.numeric(quantile(cell_lens, probs = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE))
    cell_max <- max(cell_lens, nchar(hdr_str), na.rm = TRUE)
    eff_len <- max(nchar(hdr_str) * 0.42, min(cell_max, max(cell_q85, 6.0)))
    col_weights[c_idx] <- max(3.5, eff_len ^ 0.65)
  }

  if (sum(min_frac) > usable_frac * 0.94) {
    min_frac <- min_frac * ((usable_frac * 0.94) / sum(min_frac))
  }
  rem_frac <- max(0.0, usable_frac - sum(min_frac))
  col_fracs <- min_frac + rem_frac * (col_weights / sum(col_weights))

  col_specs <- vapply(
    col_fracs,
    function (fr) sprintf(">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash\\hyphenpenalty=50\\exhyphenpenalty=50}p{%.4f\\textwidth}", fr),
    character(1)
  )
  align_str <- paste(col_specs, collapse = "")

  header_cells <- vapply(
    seq_len(n_cols),
    function (c_idx) {
      clean_h <- sanitize_latex_text(col_names[c_idx], TRUE)
      paste0("{\\karlabold\\lefthyphenmin=5\\righthyphenmin=5 ", clean_h, "}")
    },
    character(1)
  )
  header_line <- paste0(paste(header_cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\*[4pt]")

  cap_tex <- sanitize_latex_text(caption_str, FALSE)
  lbl_tex <- if (nzchar(label_str)) paste0("\\label{", label_str, "}") else ""
  row_pt <- if (n_rows >= 14L) "1pt" else "2pt"
  arr_str <- if (n_rows >= 14L) "1.0" else "1.08"

  block_lines <- c(
    paste0(strrep("\x60", 3), "{=latex}"),
    "\\par\\vspace{4pt}",
    "\\begingroup\\fontsize{10pt}{14pt}\\selectfont\\normalfont\\rmfamily\\mdseries",
    "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}",
    paste0("\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{", arr_str, "}"),
    "\\setlength{\\LTpre}{4pt}",
    "\\setlength{\\LTpost}{4pt}",
    "\\setlength{\\LTcapwidth}{\\textwidth}",
    paste0("\\begin{longtable}[l]{@{}", align_str, "@{}}"),
    header_line,
    "\\endfirsthead",
    paste0("\\multicolumn{", n_cols, "}{@{}l@{}}{\\normalfont\\karlalight\\fontsize{9pt}{12pt}\\selectfont (Continued from previous page)} \\\\*[3pt]"),
    header_line,
    "\\endhead"
  )

  for (r_idx in seq_len(n_rows)) {
    row_cells <- vapply(
      seq_len(n_cols),
      function (c_idx) {
        raw_v <- df[r_idx, c_idx]
        val_str <- if (is.null(raw_v) || is.na(raw_v)) "-" else as.character(raw_v)
        val_str <- trimws(gsub("\\*\\*", "", val_str))
        if (euro_decimals) {
          val_str <- convert_euro_decimals_in_text(val_str)
        }
        clean_v <- sanitize_latex_text(val_str, TRUE)
        paste0("{\\normalfont\\rmfamily\\mdseries\\lefthyphenmin=4\\righthyphenmin=4\\hspace{0pt} ", clean_v, "}")
      },
      character(1)
    )
    # Prevent page breaks inside the first 3 rows or the last 4 rows so tables never orphan 1-3 rows
    row_end <- paste0("\\\\[", row_pt, "]")
    if (r_idx == n_rows && (nzchar(cap_tex) || nzchar(lbl_tex))) {
      row_end <- "\\\\*[5pt]"
    }
    block_lines <- c(block_lines, paste0(paste(row_cells, collapse = " & "), " ", row_end))
  }

  if (nzchar(cap_tex) || nzchar(lbl_tex)) {
    block_lines <- c(block_lines, paste0("\\caption{", cap_tex, "}", lbl_tex, "\\\\"))
  }
  block_lines <- c(
    block_lines,
    "\\end{longtable}\\endgroup",
    "\\vspace{4pt}\\par",
    strrep("\x60", 3)
  )

  return(knitr::asis_output(paste(block_lines, collapse = "\n")))
}
orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}


orig_sanitize_latex_text <- sanitize_latex_text
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  res <- orig_sanitize_latex_text(arg0_text, arg1_in_table)
  if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
    res <- gsub("Preobrazhenka", "Preobra\\-zhenka", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Timiryazevskoye", "Timirya\\-zevskoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Timiryazevo", "Timirya\\-zevo", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Nyakhsimvol", "Nyakh\\-simvol", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Molchanovo", "Molcha\\-novo", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Gorodishche", "Gorod\\-ishche", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Zavodoukovsk", "Zavodo\\-ukovsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Presnogorkovskaya", "Presno\\-gorkov\\-skaya", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Zhelezinskaya", "Zhele\\-zinskaya", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Yamyshevskaya", "Yamy\\-shevskaya", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Novonikolayevsk", "Novoniko\\-layevsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Ust-Kamenogorsk", "Ust-Kameno\\-gorsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Semipalatinsk", "Semipala\\-tinsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Petropavlovsk", "Petropav\\-lovsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Belokurikha", "Beloku\\-rikha", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Novobelo", "Novo\\-belo", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Chernorechye", "Cherno\\-rechye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Roshchinskoye", "Roshchin\\-skoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Likhachevskoye", "Likha\\-chevskoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Rafailovskoye", "Rafai\\-lovskoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Kondinskoye", "Kondin\\-skoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Peregrebnoye", "Peregreb\\-noye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Bolsherechye", "Bolshe\\-rechye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Demyanskoye", "Demyan\\-skoye", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Zmeinogorsk", "Zmeino\\-gorsk", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("serebroplavilnyy", "serebro\\-plavilnyy", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Karamovskiy", "Kara\\-movskiy", res, fixed = TRUE)
    res <- gsub("Odintsovskoe", "Odin\\-tsovskoe", res, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  return(res)
}

stadester_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON("siberia_ob_irtysh_steppe_and_yugra_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

translit_cyrillic <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  if (length(s) == 0 || is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return("")
  cyr <- c(
    "А"="A","Б"="B","В"="V","Г"="G","Д"="D","Е"="E","Ё"="Yo","Ж"="Zh","З"="Z","И"="I","Й"="Y",
    "К"="K","Л"="L","М"="M","Н"="N","О"="O","П"="P","Р"="R","С"="S","Т"="T","У"="U","Ф"="F",
    "Х"="Kh","Ц"="Ts","Ч"="Ch","Ш"="Sh","Щ"="Shch","Ъ"="","Ы"="Y","Ь"="","Э"="E","Ю"="Yu","Я"="Ya",
    "а"="a","б"="b","в"="v","г"="g","д"="d","е"="e","ё"="yo","ж"="zh","з"="z","и"="i","й"="y",
    "к"="k","л"="l","м"="m","н"="n","о"="o","п"="p","р"="r","с"="s","т"="t","у"="u","ф"="f",
    "х"="kh","ц"="ts","ч"="ch","ш"="sh","щ"="shch","ъ"="","ы"="y","ь"="","э"="e","ю"="yu","я"="ya"
  )
  for (ch in names(cyr)) {
    s <- gsub(ch, cyr[[ch]], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  return(s)
}

get_alt_name <- function (arg0_item) {
  others <- unlist(arg0_item$other_names)
  if (length(others) == 0) return("-")
  non_cyr <- others[!grepl("[\u0400-\u04FF]", others, perl = TRUE)]
  if (length(non_cyr) > 0) {
    return(non_cyr[1])
  }
  if (length(others) >= 2L) {
    return(translit_cyrillic(others[2]))
  }
  return(translit_cyrillic(others[1]))
}

fmt_coords <- function (arg0_item) {
  co <- unlist(arg0_item$coords)
  s <- sprintf("%.2f N, %.2f E", as.numeric(co[1]), as.numeric(co[2]))
  return(gsub("\\.", ",", s))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.integer(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(y), "BC"))
  return(paste0(y, "AD"))
}

get_span_str <- function (arg0_item) {
  yrs <- sort(as.integer(names(arg0_item$population)))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  y1 <- yrs[1]
  y2 <- yrs[length(yrs)]
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(abs(y1), " BC - ", y2, "AD"))
}

get_founded_str <- function (arg0_item) {
  yrs <- sort(as.integer(names(arg0_item$population)))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  return(as.character(yrs[1]))
}

fmt_pop_val <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- sprintf("%.1fk", v / 1000.0)
    return(gsub("\\.", ",", s))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

get_pop_in_range <- function (arg0_item, arg1_min_y, arg2_max_y) {
  pop_list <- arg0_item$population
  yrs <- as.integer(names(pop_list))
  in_rng <- which(yrs >= arg1_min_y & yrs <= arg2_max_y)
  if (length(in_rng) == 0) return("-")
  # Take the latest or peak value in the window
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_list[in_rng]))
  best_v <- vals[length(vals)]
  return(fmt_pop_val(best_v))
}

build_group_df <- function (arg0_keys, arg1_ranges, arg2_use_founded = FALSE) {
  rows <- lapply(arg0_keys, function (k) {
    full_k <- paste0(k, "-Russia")
    item <- stadester_data[[full_k]]
    if (is.null(item)) stop(paste("Missing key in JSON:", full_k))
    base_df <- data.frame(
      Settlement = as.character(item$name),
      AltName = get_alt_name(item),
      Coords = fmt_coords(item),
      Span = if (arg2_use_founded) get_founded_str(item) else get_span_str(item),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    for (rng_name in names(arg1_ranges)) {
      rng <- arg1_ranges[[rng_name]]
      base_df[[rng_name]] <- get_pop_in_range(item, rng[1], rng[2])
    }
    return(base_df)
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, rows))
}
```

# Introduction

This gazetteer compiles the geographical coordinates, historical and indigenous names, occupation spans, and benchmark population histories of 193 individual settlements across Western Siberia (the Ob-Irtysh river basin, ~2,40M km²) from 6000BC to 1900AD [@Chernykh2022]. Reading directly from `siberia_ob_irtysh_steppe_and_yugra_settlements.json` in the standard `population_Stadester` format, the dataset covers prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Iron Age settlements across the Altai region (I-1), the South-West Siberian Steppe and Forest-Steppe (I-2), and the North-West Siberian Taiga, Tundra, and Yugra (I-3), followed by medieval Ob-Ugrian, Selkup, Turkic, and Siberian Tatar fortified centres (*gorodki* and *gorodishcha*), and early modern to Imperial Russian towns, *ostrogi*, factory settlements (*zavody*), and *slobody*.

Prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Iron Age settlement populations are estimated from excavated house counts, dwelling floor areas ($4,5\text{ m}^2$ per person with a contemporaneity factor of $0,65$ to $0,80$), and geomagnetic settlement plans [@Piezonka2023; @Dubovtseva2020; @Borzunov2012; @Ryabogina2010; @Outram2009; @Epimakhov2009; @Krause2019; @Molodin2009; @Matveeva1999; @Losey2018; @Grushin2011; @Dashkovskiy2024]. Medieval Yugra and Siberian Khanate populations combine excavated *gorodishche* house counts with 17th-century Russian fur-tribute (*yasak*) registers using B. O. Dolgikh's household multipliers ($4,0$ per adult male payer for Ob-Ugrian and Selkup communities and $4,5$ to $5,0$ for Siberian Tatar *yurts*) [@Dolgikh1960; @Bakhrushin1935; @Kardash2009; @Vizgalov2008; @Vizgalov2011; @Solodkin2015; @Tataurov2016; @Maslyuzhenko2018; @Matveev2011; @Vodyasov2016; @Vodyasov2017; @Gorbunov2018]. Early modern and 18th- to 19th-century urban and *sloboda* populations are drawn from 17th-century garrison and household rosters (*dozornye* and *perepisnye knigi*), the ten Imperial Poll-Tax Revisions (1719-1858) [@Kabuzan1990; @Kolesnikov1973; @Rezun1989; @Korusenko2011], and the First All-Russian Imperial Census of 1897 [@Patkanov1911; @Tychinskikh2019; @Bryukhanova2021].

# Prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Iron Age Settlements (6000BC - 500AD)

Table \ref{tab:neolithic_bronze_sites} lists the 45 Neolithic, Eneolithic, and Bronze Age settlements (6000-700BC), and Table \ref{tab:early_iron_sites} lists the 24 Early Iron Age settlements (600BC - 500AD) compiled in `siberia_ob_irtysh_steppe_and_yugra_settlements.json`.

# Early Modern and Imperial Towns, Ostrogs, and Slobodas (1586 - 1900AD)
